name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 01: The Quantum Beacon
description: Emergency beacon over Base-37 alphabet (abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_) with alternating positional shifts. Even i: shift +(i+7) mod 37, Odd i: shift -(i*3+5) mod 37. Cipher: mdj3{tgd7989ete90r0e0isn_oorb}. Download cipher.txt.
hints: Hint 1: Alphabet has 37 symbols (0 pts) | Hint 2: Invert even indices by subtracting (i+7)%37, odd by adding (i*3+5)%37 (10 pts) | Hint 3: Python loop with alphabet indexing (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 02: Rendezvous in Paris
description: Encrypted dispatch using Autokey cipher starting with primer PARIS. Keystream dynamically fed by decrypted plaintext letters: K_i = P_{i-5}. Cipher: ulro{szeoqes_wspiyww_fm_pkgmxizbs}. Download cipher.txt.
hints: Hint 1: Autokey cipher appends plaintext to primer to extend keystream (0 pts) | Hint 2: Decrypt letter-by-letter sequentially (10 pts) | Hint 3: keystream.append(p_char) as each letter is decrypted (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 03: The Intercepted Droid
description: Downed recon droid using Affine cipher over Base-37 prime alphabet: E(x) = (a*x + b) mod 37. Cipher: e7xp{hntv7uzmuzyk0hjkyimy_m_vdjzynz}. Download cipher.txt and affine.py.
hints: Hint 1: Prime modulus 37, 36*37=1332 keys (0 pts) | Hint 2: Brute force in Python using pow(a, -1, 37) (10 pts) | Hint 3: Keys are a=11, b=23 (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 04: The XORd of Damocles
description: Perimeter sentries use LCG PRNG stream: S_{i+1} = (137*S_i + 73) mod 256. Unknown seed S_0 in range 0..255. Cipher hex: 4cafc56a451b9b668ddbbe1b8100531d4ee7c782e73417a5124b43365b1b1c55b7. Download cipher.txt and xor.py.
hints: Hint 1: Keystream is S_{i+1}=(137*S_i + 73)%256 with seed 0..255 (0 pts) | Hint 2: Iterate through 256 seeds and check for flag{ (10 pts) | Hint 3: Seed is 42 (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 05: The Double Agent's Dilemma
description: Emergency alerts encrypted with One-Time Pad key reuse: C1 ^ C2 = P1 ^ P2. Message 1 known prefix: 'OPERATION CIPHERFALL: '. Download ciphertexts.txt and encrypt.py.
hints: Hint 1: Key reuse allows crib dragging (0 pts) | Hint 2: XOR C1 with 'OPERATION CIPHERFALL: ' reveals key start (10 pts) | Hint 3: P1 is 'OPERATION CIPHERFALL: AGENT VANCE ESCAPED VIA SECTOR 04!' (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 06: Protocol DH-9000
description: Command satellite Diffie-Hellman handshake: p=19997, g=5, A=2058, B=5125. Key = SHA256(str(S)). Encrypted hex: dcb3befd8907a8e142d9f6351d054d4c8f5810082a9600fba1259d9a115b57f1dea2. Download params.txt and dh.py.
hints: Hint 1: Find Alice secret 'a' with pow(5, a, 19997)==2058 (0 pts) | Hint 2: Shared secret S = pow(B, a, p), derive key with SHA256 (10 pts) | Hint 3: a=13371, S=18857 (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 07: The Mastermind's Vault
description: Syndicate RSA-512 key with prime sum S = p + q given. Use (p-q)^2 = S^2 - 4*N to factor modulus and decrypt. Download rsa.txt and encrypt.py.
hints: Hint 1: (p - q)^2 = S^2 - 4*N (0 pts) | Hint 2: math.isqrt(S*S - 4*N) gives p - q (10 pts) | Hint 3: Recover p, q, compute phi and d=pow(e,-1,phi) (25 pts)

name: Operation Cipherfall - Ep 08: Baby One-Round
description: (Inspired by ECSC 2024 / CryptoHack) Custom block cipher with AES S-Box, nibble permutation swap, and dual round keys (1 round only). Invert step-by-step. Download cipher.txt and chall.py.
hints: Hint 1: Single SPN round is invertible in reverse order (0 pts) | Hint 2: Nibble swap is self-inverting (10 pts) | Hint 3: XOR with K1, swap nibbles, inverse S-box, XOR with K0 (25 pts)
